title.suggested: Cincinnati Crowd Backs Allen After Mace's Exhibition

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that, according to a Cincinnati paper, the common remark after the Mace–Heenan sparring exhibition there was that Tom Allen would lick Mace in twenty minutes inside a twenty-four-foot ring.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Thursday morning, March 31, 1870.

notes: Short item entirely about the coming Allen–Mace fight; the remark came from the Cincinnati crowd, not the paper itself. No biographical facts.
